about: Organisations in the Algarve that a founder, a company or a student can turn to, compiled from PrompTugal.news public research. Organisations only: no private person is listed. Each entry keeps its source and the date it was read. Text CC BY 4.0 (PrompTugal.news); compiled by sites-dev@AgentiCCells.dinis with scripts/pages/_talent-map-data.mjs.

organisations.name: + Proximo teleassistance (Alcoutim council with the Tavira humanitarian centre of the Portuguese Red Cross)
organisations.what: Teleassistance for isolated people aged 65 or over, running since 2020, now paid by the council.
organisations.ai: Alarm devices and a support centre produce the data and the connection on which AI monitoring of isolated seniors would be built. No AI is mentioned.
organisations.pt: Teleassistência para pessoas isoladas com 65 ou mais anos, a funcionar desde 2020 e agora paga pela câmara.

organisations.name: ACRAL, Associação do Comércio e Serviços da Região do Algarve
organisations.what: Algarve commerce and services association, a consortium partner for Quarteira's digital commercial neighbourhood.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Associação do comércio e serviços do Algarve, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.

organisations.name: ADJ3 Sistemas
organisations.what: Faro web and app developer that builds sites and portals for universities and municipalities on Drupal and React, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its site lists AI services integrated with Drupal: chatbots that answer from a site's own content, smart search, and assistants for content editors.
organisations.ai: It sells AI chatbots, search and editing assistants for public-interest websites.
organisations.pt: Empresa de Faro que desenvolve sites e aplicações, constrói sites e portais para universidades e municípios em Drupal e React, e é membro da Algarve Evolution. O seu site lista serviços de IA integrados com o Drupal: chatbots que respondem a partir do conteúdo do próprio site, pesquisa inteligente e assistentes para editores de conteúdo.

organisations.name: AEA, Associação de Empresários do Algarve
organisations.what: Algarve business association, a consortium partner for Quarteira's digital commercial neighbourhood.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Associação empresarial do Algarve, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.

organisations.name: AGROBOTICS-DITWINS
organisations.what: Interreg SUDOE project led by the University of Málaga, with 13 partners from Spain, Portugal and France, building robotics, AI and digital-twin living labs for agriculture to May 2028. NERA and UAlg lead the Algarve pilot.
organisations.ai: The project tests AI and robotics on farms.
organisations.pt: Projeto Interreg SUDOE liderado pela Universidade de Málaga, com 13 parceiros de Espanha, Portugal e França, que cria laboratórios vivos de robótica, IA e gémeos digitais para a agricultura até maio de 2028. A NERA e a UAlg lideram o piloto do Algarve.

organisations.name: Agrosocial Plus (Interreg Spain-Portugal, Odiana as Lower Guadiana partner)
organisations.what: A cross-border agrifood social economy and innovation project coordinated by the Diputacion de Cordoba, planning Living Labs for AI, IoT and smart irrigation.
organisations.ai: The labs are planned to test AI directly. No lab location in Alcoutim is confirmed.
organisations.pt: Projeto transfronteiriço de economia social e inovação agroalimentar, coordenado pela Diputación de Córdoba, que prevê laboratórios vivos de IA, IoT e rega inteligente.

organisations.name: AI Aumentar, Lda.
organisations.what: Listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. The member page gives no description and links to concha-ai.com, a decision-intelligence product for leadership hiring, but that site does not mention AI Aumentar, so the link between them is unconfirmed. Needs its own source.
organisations.ai: Its name points to AI, which is unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Listada como membro da Algarve Evolution. A página de membros não indica descrição, concelho nem produto: o nome sugere uma área de IA, que não confirmámos. Precisa de fonte própria.

organisations.name: AI4Youth Work (Erasmus+ project, with Contextos and Algarve STP)
organisations.what: An Erasmus+ project to help youth workers use AI tools, with partners in Portugal, Greece, Italy and Romania. Its Algarve session was held at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 2 April 2025.
organisations.ai: A European project on AI for youth work, presented in Faro.
organisations.pt: Um projeto Erasmus+ para ajudar animadores juvenis a usar ferramentas de IA, com parceiros em Portugal, na Grécia, em Itália e na Roménia. A sessão no Algarve realizou-se no UALG TEC Campus, em Faro, a 2 de abril de 2025.

organisations.name: Alcoutim Business Park (Parque Empresarial de Alcoutim)
organisations.what: The council's industrial estate: 54,320 square metres in 26 lots, 23 of them for industrial units, between the EN 122, the EN 124 and the new IC27, about 30 kilometres from the coast and Spain and about 6 kilometres from the town. The council publishes the park's regulation as a PDF on the same page, and the page is dated 4 November 2025.
organisations.pt: A zona industrial da câmara: 54.320 metros quadrados em 26 lotes, 23 para unidades industriais, entre a EN 122, a EN 124 e o novo IC27. A câmara publica o regulamento do parque na mesma página.

organisations.name: ALGAR, Valorização e Tratamento de Resíduos Sólidos
organisations.what: Waste company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Almancil, which serves the whole Algarve. With the start-up NILG.AI it built an AI tool that chooses sites for recycling points, piloted in Lagoa. UPTEC's page says the pilot also covers São Brás de Alportel.
organisations.ai: It builds and runs an AI tool for site selection.
organisations.pt: Empresa de resíduos fundada em 1995, com sede em Almancil, que serve todo o Algarve. Com a startup NILG.AI criou uma ferramenta de IA que escolhe locais para ecopontos, testada em Lagoa.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 (FEDER) in the council's digitisation project
organisations.what: EU regional funding for digital infrastructure, online services and cybersecurity at the council.
organisations.ai: Groundwork for AI in services, not AI itself.
organisations.pt: Fundos regionais europeus para infraestrutura digital, serviços online e cibersegurança na câmara.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 and Algarve Empreende 2026
organisations.what: Regional programme money behind Venture Lab, UAlg's proof-of-concept programme, and the AI and robotics pilot for 15 tourism SMEs.
organisations.ai: Pays for AI adoption and mentoring programmes run from Faro: one step from AI.
organisations.pt: Fundos do programa regional por trás do Venture Lab, do programa de prova de conceito da UAlg e do piloto de IA e robótica para 15 PME do turismo.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme
organisations.what: Co-finances half of the more than 3.5 million euro Estádio Algarve technology centre and the Inova Algarve 3.0 AI and robotics pilot for tourism firms.
organisations.ai: The centre lists AI among its themes: the funding, then the centre, then AI firms.
organisations.amount: more than 3.5 million euros total, 50% Algarve 2030
organisations.pt: Cofinancia metade do centro tecnológico do Estádio Algarve, de mais de 3,5 milhões de euros, e o piloto de IA e robótica Inova Algarve 3.0 para empresas do turismo.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 regional programme (FEDER) in the Celeiro de Ideias centre
organisations.what: EU regional funding for the council's business and coworking centre.
organisations.ai: It pays for the space where startups would sit. No AI tenant is announced.
organisations.pt: Fundos regionais europeus para o centro de empresas e coworking da câmara.

organisations.name: Algarve 2030 territorial incentive scheme (SIBT), notice ALGARVE-2026-5
organisations.what: A 5 million euro call for micro and small companies to create, expand or modernise, with up to 60 percent co-financing and special weight for inland, low-density territories. Priority areas include digitalisation and information and communication technologies. Applications are open until 15 January 2027, assessed in rounds ending 30 July, 30 October 2026 and 15 January 2027. The council posts the notice on its own site.
organisations.pt: Aviso de 5 milhões de euros para micro e pequenas empresas criarem, expandirem ou modernizarem, com cofinanciamento até 60 por cento e peso especial para territórios do interior. Candidaturas abertas até 15 de janeiro de 2027.

organisations.name: Algarve 6.0 Smart Territorial Hub (Alcoutim, Olhao, Loule, Sao Bras de Alportel, Tavira, Vila Real de Santo Antonio)
organisations.what: A PRR project of six municipalities to build an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network, including monitoring of isolated elderly residents. Alcoutim's assigned funding is 124.32 thousand euros, and the project is due to end on 30 June 2026.
organisations.ai: Sensors and a LoRaWAN network feed one data platform, and a shared data platform is where analytics and AI services get built. The project page does not mention AI.

also.what: Intermunicipal recovery-plan project with six Algarve councils to set up an urban management platform and digital tools.

A PRR digital public administration project of 1.13 million euros, run through the state's technological reform agency, to put an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network in six Algarve municipalities. Vila Real de Santo António is assigned 140.74 thousand euros, with nothing spent on the day we read the page. Planned areas include incident management, waste, water use, air quality, green spaces and monitoring isolated elderly residents. The page gives an expected end date of 30 June 2026.

PRR-funded project (1.13 million euros, September 2023 to June 2026) to put an urban management platform with sensors and a LoRaWAN network across six municipalities: Olhão, Alcoutim, Loulé, São Brás de Alportel, Tavira and Vila Real de Santo António. Town files name it in their own words.

organisations.pt: Projeto PRR de seis municípios para uma plataforma de gestão urbana com sensores e rede LoRaWAN, incluindo o acompanhamento de idosos isolados.

organisations.name: Algarve AI Agents
organisations.what: An AI community that BeAlgarve's ecosystem directory lists for Faro and Loulé. We found no page of its own, so its activity is unverified.
organisations.ai: A community dedicated to AI, as listed by the directory.

also.what: An AI community covering Faro and Loulé, as BeAlgarve lists it. No page of its own found yet.

Community listed as AI-related in the Algarve entrepreneurship ecosystem directory and, per our newsroom, part of the Algarve Digital Innovators network. The directory gives no website: needs a primary source.

organisations.pt: Comunidade de IA que o diretório do ecossistema BeAlgarve indica em Faro e Loulé. Não encontrámos página própria, por isso a sua atividade não está verificada.

organisations.name: Algarve Digital Innovators
organisations.what: Network of digital communities across the Algarve, supported by Algarve Evolution. Reported to include GDG Faro, Flutter Faro and Algarve AI Agents (our own newsroom's reading, to be re-checked at source).
organisations.ai: The network includes AI and developer communities.
organisations.pt: Rede de comunidades digitais em todo o Algarve, apoiada pela Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: Algarve Evolution
organisations.what: Association of entrepreneurs, talent and startups (106 active members by its own count) building an innovation ecosystem in the Algarve. Ran Vibathon Algarve 2026 in Faro on 31 October, runs the AI and Robotics programme for 15 tourism SMEs, and hosts events in Faro including one on UAlgTec Heritage on 17 November. Its pages do not state a base city.
organisations.ai: Runs an AI and robotics adoption programme and the regional digital ecosystem.

also.what: Lists an incubator, the Founder2Founder growth programme and INOVA Algarve 3.0 for tourism firms adopting AI and robotics.
Regional association of more than 100 professionals and companies, partner of GDG Lagos events, with an AI and Robotics project for tourism SMEs.

Regional association named as one of the stakeholders engaged to link the November 2026 TMCT conference in Portimão to regional business, institutional and education partners. Its exact role is not stated in the source.

Faro-based association of entrepreneurs, talent, startups, SMEs and partners that runs the Algarve Innovation Hub and incubator. It runs the regional AI adoption survey and the AI and robotics tourism programme, co-organised the Vibathon with Lovable, and its incubator takes technical founders building AI and software products.

organisations.pt: Associação de empreendedores, talento e startups (106 membros ativos, segundo a própria) que constrói um ecossistema de inovação no Algarve. Organizou o Vibathon Algarve 2026 em Faro a 31 de outubro e gere o programa de IA e Robótica para 15 PME do turismo.

organisations.name: Algarve Innovation and Technology Park (PPPITA), Pechão
organisations.what: Planned 48.58 hectare park in Pechão for technology companies, education and research, health and green space, with land for 548 public homes. A contract signed in August 2024 started its detailed plan, with 18 months for the landowner to finalise it. Whether it has progressed since is not confirmed.
organisations.ai: A site meant for technology companies, where AI firms could locate. The article names no AI sector: a 3-step entry, labelled as a plan.
organisations.pt: Parque planeado de 48,58 hectares em Pechão para empresas de tecnologia, ensino e investigação, saúde e espaços verdes. Não está confirmado se avançou desde 2024.

organisations.name: Algarve Smart Destination, Digital Innovation Hub
organisations.what: An informal network led by the non-profit Algarve STP, in the European Commission's hub catalogue. Loulé is one of its three partner municipalities, with Faro and Olhão, alongside the University of the Algarve, ANJE, Algarve Evolution, Altis and Fraunhofer Portugal. Its focus areas include AI and deep learning for tourism and digital marketing. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.
organisations.ai: Loulé is a partner municipality of a hub whose focus areas include AI for tourism.
organisations.pt: Uma rede informal liderada pelo Algarve STP, entidade sem fins lucrativos, que consta do catálogo de polos da Comissão Europeia. Loulé é um dos seus três municípios parceiros, com Faro e Olhão, ao lado da Universidade do Algarve, da ANJE, da Algarve Evolution, da Altis e da Fraunhofer Portugal. As suas áreas incluem IA e aprendizagem profunda para o turismo e o marketing digital. Encontrada pelo detective.places@ e lida por nós a 16 de novembro de 2026.

organisations.name: Algarve STP
organisations.what: Science and technology park association that ran the first Venture Lab (12 firms, AI among the sectors) and co-hosted the July 2026 AI panel at UALG TEC Campus.
organisations.ai: Mentors AI startups and hosts AI events.

also.what: Regional technology and innovation body, a named organiser of the Algarve Tech Hub Summit held in Lagos in November 2025.

Named as partner of the July 2026 Faro AI search panel and as support for the UAlgTec Heritage presentation, and as promoter of the Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP, a free mentoring programme for 12 Algarve startups and SMEs funded by ALGARVE 2030. Its own site serves a bot challenge to automated readers, so its role is read through the press.

partner.note: Science and technology park; partner in ADI, Venture Lab, the Tech Hub Summit and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: Associação de parque de ciência e tecnologia que organizou o primeiro Venture Lab (12 empresas, com a IA entre os setores) e coorganizou o painel de IA de julho de 2026 no UALG TEC Campus.

organisations.name: Altice Labs, Olhão hub
organisations.what: Altice Labs opened its Algarve hub in Olhão on 12 May 2021. Projects were already running, some with the University of Algarve, including AI algorithms for studying the retina.
organisations.ai: Reported AI work on retina images with the University of Algarve (2021 report).
organisations.pt: A Altice Labs abriu o seu polo do Algarve em Olhão a 12 de maio de 2021, com projetos já em curso, alguns com a Universidade do Algarve.

organisations.name: AMAL, the Algarve intermunicipal community
organisations.what: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

partner.note: The Algarve's intermunicipal community; partner in ADI, Venture Lab and the 2025 Web Summit project.

organisations.pt: A comunidade intermunicipal do Algarve; parceira da ADI, do Venture Lab e do projeto Web Summit 2025.

organisations.name: ANJE, national association of young entrepreneurs
organisations.what: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

partner.note: National association of young entrepreneurs; partner in ADI and Venture Lab; ran the 2025 Web Summit competition.

organisations.pt: Associação nacional de jovens empresários; parceira da ADI e do Venture Lab; organizou o concurso Web Summit 2025.

organisations.name: Antrix and Carvoeiro Branco: purchase of the Fábrica do Inglês
organisations.what: Two Algarve property developers bought the 1894 cork factory, empty since 2009, to reopen the cork museum, add a boutique hotel and move their offices there. Not AI.
organisations.pt: Dois promotores imobiliários algarvios compraram a fábrica de cortiça de 1894, vazia desde 2009, para reabrir o museu da cortiça, acrescentar um hotel boutique e instalar lá os seus escritórios. Não é IA.

organisations.name: AP Hotels & Resorts
organisations.what: A hotel group whose portfolio includes resorts the release places in Albufeira, named by supplier LodgIQ as a user of its AI revenue management platform.
organisations.ai: Hotel group uses an AI pricing platform, per the supplier's release.
organisations.pt: Grupo hoteleiro com resorts em Albufeira, indicado pelo fornecedor LodgIQ como utilizador da sua plataforma de gestão de receitas com IA.

organisations.name: Artificial Intelligence Algarve
organisations.what: Community that appears as an 'AIA Artificial Intelligence Algarve' category on Algarve Evolution's events page and is listed as AI-related in the BEALG ecosystem directory. The events page showed no event under it when read. Needs its own public page.
organisations.ai: Its name and the events category are about AI.
organisations.pt: Comunidade listada como ligada à IA no diretório do ecossistema empreendedor do Algarve. Precisa de uma fonte pública primária.

organisations.name: Associação de Empresários Por Quarteira
organisations.what: Local business association of Quarteira, a consortium partner for the digital commercial neighbourhood.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Associação empresarial local de Quarteira, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital.

organisations.name: Associação de Municípios Loulé/Faro (Estádio Algarve centre)
organisations.what: Joint body of the two councils tendering a technology centre at the Estádio Algarve that names AI among its themes.
organisations.ai: It is building a tech centre that lists AI among its themes.
organisations.pt: Entidade conjunta das duas câmaras que lançou o concurso de um centro tecnológico no Estádio Algarve que inclui a IA entre os seus temas.

organisations.name: Associacao Odiana
organisations.what: Local development association named by the Galp Foundation as social partner in Alcoutim, helping run Vilas em Movimento including its senior-isolation activities. Portuguese partner for the Lower Guadiana in the Agrosocial Plus project.
organisations.ai: Odiana is the Lower Guadiana's partner in Agrosocial Plus, whose Living Labs plan to test AI and IoT, and it already runs Alcoutim's senior and bike programmes. Whether any lab or pilot lands in Alcoutim is open.
organisations.pt: Associação de desenvolvimento local, parceira social da Fundação Galp em Alcoutim no Vilas em Movimento, e parceira portuguesa do Baixo Guadiana no projeto Agrosocial Plus.

organisations.name: AuroraMed
organisations.what: Portuguese health-tech company applying AI to clinical management, which launched an AI course with UAlg's medical faculty in Faro.
organisations.ai: Sells AI for healthcare and trains its leaders.

also.what: Portuguese healthtech focused on AI in clinical management, partner of the UAlg healthcare AI executive course. The article does not say where it is based: location to confirm.

organisations.pt: Empresa portuguesa de tecnologia da saúde que aplica IA à gestão clínica e lançou um curso de IA com a faculdade de medicina da UAlg, em Faro.

organisations.name: Ayuntamiento de Ayamonte
organisations.what: Spanish council across the river, in the Eurocidade with VRSA. In March 2024 it said it was preparing an AI virtual assistant and a Eurocidade innovation node. It sits outside the municipality and is listed as the cross-border neighbour.
organisations.ai: Its own AI virtual assistant, in preparation as of March 2024.
organisations.pt: Câmara espanhola do outro lado do rio, na Eurocidade com VRSA. Em março de 2024 disse estar a preparar um assistente virtual com IA. Está fora do município e é listada como vizinha transfronteiriça.

organisations.name: B.Efficient
organisations.what: Runs EMARP's active leak-detection campaign over 130 km of the public water network. Its location is not stated in the source.
organisations.ai: Works on the same programme as the AI loggers, so AI monitoring and field detection go together.
organisations.pt: Faz a campanha de deteção ativa de fugas da EMARP em 130 km da rede pública de água. A fonte não indica a sua localização.

organisations.name: Bairro Comercial Digital de Quarteira (Câmara de Loulé, ACRAL, IAPMEI)
organisations.what: A PRR project of 1.01 million euros, 2023 to 2025, for online shops, a digital tourist guide and smart signage, run by the Loulé council with the Algarve commerce association ACRAL.
organisations.ai: Digitising local shops creates the data and skills AI retail tools need. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Projeto PRR de 1,01 milhões de euros, de 2023 a 2025, para lojas online, um guia turístico digital e sinalética inteligente, gerido pela Câmara de Loulé com a ACRAL.

organisations.name: Bot Gonçalves
organisations.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that uses AI and satellite imagery to monitor critical infrastructure. The article gives no town: needs a primary source.
organisations.ai: Its product is AI applied to satellite imagery.
organisations.pt: Empresa do Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP que usa IA e imagens de satélite para monitorizar infraestruturas críticas. O artigo não indica o concelho.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
organisations.what: The council is introducing a digital planning document system and, per the vendor, plans an online planning service with AI. Its own urbanismo page lists a GeoPortal and online services and does not mention AI.
organisations.ai: A public body adopting AI-enabled software for citizen services (planned).

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim, general office
contacts.channel: General email expediente@cm-castromarim.pt and phone +351 281 510 740, office hours 9:00 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 17:00, as published on the council's business-support page and in the Contactos Gerais block of its home page

organisations.pt: A câmara está a introduzir um sistema digital de documentos de urbanismo e, segundo o fornecedor, planeia um serviço online de urbanismo com IA.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Faro
organisations.what: The council lists a month-long AI-themed library event and an AI exhibition in November 2026. It also updates its urban-planning submission platform, with no AI use stated.
organisations.ai: Hosts public AI events, with no AI use in its own services found.

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Faro, economic development (Faro Invest)
contacts.channel: the council's economic development email, published on its Desenvolvimento económico page (open the linked page for the address)

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Faro, general
contacts.channel: the council's general email, published in the footer and on its Contactos page (open the linked page for the address)

organisations.pt: A câmara anuncia um mês de atividades sobre IA na biblioteca e uma exposição sobre IA em novembro de 2026.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Lagos
organisations.what: Co-organised DevFest Lagos 2025 and the International Women's Day Build with AI event, which was held in its Town Hall, and co-organised the 2025 Algarve Tech Hub Summit.
organisations.ai: A public body that hosts and co-organises AI events.
organisations.pt: Coorganizou o DevFest Lagos 2025, o evento Build with AI do Dia Internacional da Mulher nos Paços do Concelho e a Algarve Tech Hub Summit 2025.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Loulé
organisations.what: The municipality says it has contracted AI tools for planning cases.
organisations.ai: It uses AI tools in its own processes.

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Loulé, general desk
contacts.channel: geral@cm-loule.pt, phone 289 400 600, and the Loulé 24 Horas incident line 808 289 112, as published

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Loulé, contact form

also.what: The municipality that governs Quarteira. In July 2026 it said it had contracted AI tools to support planning-permit processing.

organisations.pt: O município diz ter contratado ferramentas de IA para processos de urbanismo.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Monchique (general channels)
organisations.what: The council's general telephone, email and postal address, as published on its contacts page. The page lists no separate channel for the entrepreneurship office or the incubator.

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Monchique (general channels)
contacts.channel: Telephone 282 910 200, email geral@cm-monchique.pt, Travessa da Portela, n.º 2, 8550-470 Monchique

organisations.pt: Telefone, email e morada geral da câmara, tal como publicados na sua página de contactos. A página não indica um canal próprio para o gabinete de empreendedorismo nem para a incubadora.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Olhão
organisations.what: Council that said in 2023 it was working on AI-optimised waste routes and smart parking, and in 2026 launched the digital commerce project Olhão com Alma.
organisations.ai: Stated use of AI for waste collection routes (2023).
organisations.pt: Câmara que em 2023 disse estar a trabalhar em rotas de resíduos e estacionamento inteligente com IA e que em 2026 lançou o projeto de comércio digital Olhão com Alma.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Portimão
organisations.what: Is rolling out an online urban-management platform with an AI module that checks licensing documents on submission, and has an approved digital-transformation grant that lists AI among its areas.
organisations.ai: The council deploys AI in a public service.
organisations.pt: Está a implementar uma plataforma online de gestão urbanística com um módulo de IA que verifica os documentos de licenciamento na submissão.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Silves
organisations.what: The municipal council. It co-hosts the free Formação + Próxima training for the local tourism sector, which included an advanced AI-for-business course in March 2026, and it runs the GEL entrepreneurship office.
organisations.ai: It hosts AI training for local businesses.

contacts.label: Câmara Municipal de Silves, general channel (linked from the GEL page)
contacts.channel: expediente@cm-silves.pt, +351 282 440 800 (a call to the national fixed-line network), as published on the council's GEL page

organisations.pt: A câmara municipal. Coorganiza a formação gratuita Formação + Próxima para o turismo local, que incluiu um curso avançado de IA para empresas em março de 2026, e gere o gabinete de empreendedorismo GEL.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Tavira
organisations.what: The council is a partner in the Algarve 6.0 urban management data platform and runs parking sensors linked to the Acessibilidades 360 app.
organisations.ai: A public buyer of sensor and data platforms, the layer AI services are built on.
organisations.pt: A câmara é parceira da plataforma de dados de gestão urbana Algarve 6.0 e tem sensores de estacionamento ligados à aplicação Acessibilidades 360.

organisations.name: Camara Municipal de Vila do Bispo
organisations.what: The council's published general office channels, as listed on its own contacts page. For business and funding questions, start here.

contacts.label: Camara Municipal de Vila do Bispo, general office
contacts.channel: main switchboard 282 630 600 (national landline rate), and a general mailbox, both published on the contacts page linked here

organisations.pt: Os contactos gerais publicados pela câmara na sua página de contactos. Para questões de negócio e financiamento, comece aqui.

organisations.name: Câmara Municipal de Vila Real de Santo António
organisations.what: The council runs the VRSA Digital project (Wi-Fi, footfall counters, online marketplace), a municipal Geoportal launched in January 2025 and a new digital platform for the 2026/2027 school activity offer.
organisations.ai: A public data owner with live data projects. We found no stated use of AI.
organisations.pt: A câmara gere o projeto VRSA Digital (Wi-Fi, contadores de pessoas, mercado online), um Geoportal municipal lançado em janeiro de 2025 e uma nova plataforma digital para a oferta escolar.

organisations.name: Cáritas Diocesana do Algarve
organisations.what: Held an AI and human dignity conference at Faro's Seminário de São José on 29 October 2026.
organisations.ai: Civil society debating AI's social effects.
organisations.pt: Organizou uma conferência sobre IA e dignidade humana no Seminário de São José, em Faro, a 29 de outubro de 2026.

organisations.name: CASULO, social innovation incubator
organisations.what: Listed for Loulé by BeAlgarve as an incubator of social innovation.
organisations.pt: Listada em Loulé pelo BeAlgarve como incubadora de inovação social.

organisations.name: CCDesert, Centro de Competencias na Luta contra a Desertificacao
organisations.what: A national competence centre hosted by Alcoutim since 2018, joining the Government and more than 30 institutions in research, training and knowledge transfer on desertification, and publishing results digitally. It is also named as a partner of the Robotics4Farmers consortium.
organisations.ai: CCDesert is a named partner of Robotics4Farmers, an AI-guided agricultural robot project, which makes it a direct AI link. The project page does not say what CCDesert does in it.
organisations.pt: Centro de competências nacional sediado em Alcoutim desde 2018, que junta o Governo e mais de 30 instituições em investigação, formação e transferência de conhecimento sobre a desertificação.

organisations.name: CCDR Algarve
organisations.what: The Algarve's regional development body. Started its first AI course for its own staff in October 2025, 21 hours with ISCTE and funded by Algarve 2030. The page does not state its base city.
organisations.ai: A regional public body training its staff in AI.

also.what: Regional coordination commission. Runs the regional smart-specialisation strategy and innovation platforms, co-funds the AI programmes through ALGARVE 2030 and is hosting a 24 November conference on digitalising the water cycle with AI.

organisations.pt: O organismo de desenvolvimento regional do Algarve. Iniciou o seu primeiro curso de IA para os próprios funcionários em outubro de 2025, com o ISCTE.

organisations.name: Celeiro de Ideias (former EPAC granary business centre)
organisations.what: Municipal project to rehabilitate the old granary beside the EN 122.1 as an entrepreneurship and coworking centre, completion planned for 30 September 2028.
organisations.ai: A future home for startups and freelancers is where local AI builders could appear. No AI tenant is announced.
organisations.pt: Projeto municipal para reabilitar o antigo celeiro junto à EN 122.1 como centro de empreendedorismo e coworking, com conclusão prevista para 30 de setembro de 2028.

organisations.name: Celeiro de Ideias business and coworking centre (planned)
organisations.what: A future centre for microbusinesses, freelancers, startups and artisans in the former EPAC granary, with entrepreneurship support services. Works are due to finish on 30 September 2028, so it is not open yet.
organisations.pt: Futuro centro para microempresas, trabalhadores independentes, startups e artesãos no antigo celeiro da EPAC, com serviços de apoio ao empreendedorismo. Ainda não está aberto.

organisations.name: Celerator, Parque Tecnológico do Algarve
organisations.what: Association of Parkalgar and UAlg behind a technology hub beside the Autódromo, on mobility and energy research. Its rector links the planned UAlg campus to it for technology transfer. No AI work of its own is stated in the sources read.
organisations.ai: The planned AI-focused UAlg campus is meant to work with it on research and technology transfer.
organisations.pt: Associação da Parkalgar e da UAlg por trás de um polo tecnológico junto ao Autódromo, dedicado à investigação em mobilidade e energia.

organisations.name: Centro Ciência Viva de Tavira
organisations.what: Science centre that co-hosted, with the IPMA mollusc research station and council support, a regional school meeting of the ROV4ALL project in May 2022, where students built small remotely operated underwater robots.
organisations.ai: School robotics and programming build the skills pipeline that AI work draws on. The article describes remotely operated vehicles and mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: Centro de ciência que coorganizou, em maio de 2022, um encontro escolar do projeto ROV4ALL, onde alunos construíram pequenos robôs subaquáticos.

organisations.name: Centro de Negócios e Incubadora Level Up
organisations.what: Business centre and incubator in central Tavira, run by the municipal company EMPET, housing the town's Espaço Empresa service point (gov.pt) and listed as an accredited incubator on IAPMEI's November 2018 Vale Incubação list.
organisations.ai: An incubator is where a young AI or software startup in Tavira would most likely sit. We found no AI tenant, and the page does not mention AI.
organisations.pt: Centro de negócios e incubadora no centro de Tavira, gerido pela empresa municipal EMPET, com o balcão Espaço Empresa, e incubadora acreditada na lista Vale Incubação do IAPMEI de 2018.

organisations.name: CEOT (Centro de Eletrónica, Optoelectrónica e Telecomunicações, UAlg)
organisations.what: UAlg research centre that co-organised a 2024 workshop on deep learning for NIR chemometrics, AI applied to food control.
organisations.ai: Applies deep learning to spectroscopy data.

also.what: UAlg research centre that co-organised a 2024 workshop on deep learning for near-infrared chemometrics in food control.

organisations.pt: Centro de investigação da UAlg que coorganizou em 2024 um workshop sobre aprendizagem profunda aplicada ao controlo alimentar.

organisations.name: CIAC (UAlg research centre in arts and communication)
organisations.what: UAlg centre that opened the INTERFACE digital translation lab in Faro in October 2026, with an AI Studio extension at its Santarém hub.
organisations.ai: Its lab project includes an AI and digital literacy studio.
organisations.pt: Centro da UAlg que abriu em outubro de 2026 o laboratório de tradução digital INTERFACE, em Faro.

organisations.name: CIMA, Universidade do Algarve (SIMPATICO monitoring buoy)
organisations.what: The University of the Algarve's marine and environmental research centre runs SIMPATICO, an autonomous buoy at the mouth of the Guadiana estuary on the Portugal and Spain border. It has recorded currents, water level and water quality every hour and every 15 minutes since March 2008, and the data are open on PANGAEA. The centre is based at the university, not in the municipality.
organisations.ai: A long, open, high-frequency sensor series at the town's river mouth is the kind of dataset used to train and test forecasting models. The page mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: O centro de investigação marinha e ambiental da Universidade do Algarve opera a SIMPATICO, uma boia autónoma na foz do Guadiana que regista correntes, nível e qualidade da água desde 2008, com dados abertos.

organisations.name: CITAI-FABXR ISMAT
organisations.what: ISMAT research and making group that runs the Fabricating Futures workshop on 3D printing, biofabrication and advanced manufacturing.
organisations.ai: An ISMAT technology lab, with AI links not yet confirmed in the sources read.
organisations.pt: Grupo de investigação e fabrico do ISMAT que organiza o workshop Fabricating Futures sobre impressão 3D, biofabricação e fabrico avançado.

organisations.name: CME (digital platform for the Alcoutim shared bikes)
organisations.what: The company named as developer of the digital management and usage platform of the shared electric bikes opened in June 2026.
organisations.ai: A software platform that collects usage data is a step from data products and AI features. The article does not say CME uses AI.
organisations.pt: A empresa indicada como criadora da plataforma digital das bicicletas elétricas partilhadas, abertas em junho de 2026.

organisations.name: CoLagos, municipal coworking space
organisations.what: Run with the Lagos Youth Association (A)Garra in the old town, 20 workstations, partner of DevFest Lagos 2025.
organisations.ai: A partner of GDG Lagos's AI events and a base for remote workers.
organisations.pt: Gerido com a associação juvenil (A)Garra no centro histórico, com 20 postos de trabalho; parceiro do DevFest Lagos 2025.

organisations.name: Council online services, regulations and municipal fees
organisations.what: The council's online services portal, its regulations in force and its table of municipal fees, linked from the same business page.
organisations.pt: O portal de serviços online da câmara, os regulamentos em vigor e a tabela de taxas municipais.

organisations.name: Cowork Aljezur
organisations.what: Described in an Outsite guide (June 2026) as a small, community-oriented coworking space near Praia do Amado. Other listings say Aljezur has no coworking, so its status needs checking.
organisations.ai: A workspace for remote workers, some of whom work in software and AI. We have not found which.
organisations.pt: Descrito num guia da Outsite (junho de 2026) como um pequeno coworking comunitário perto da Praia do Amado. Outras listagens dizem que Aljezur não tem coworking, por isso é preciso confirmar.

organisations.name: Coworking spaces in São Marcos da Serra and São Bartolomeu de Messines
organisations.what: The council says it opened these at the end of 2021. A 2025 opinion column said Silves had no incubator, accelerator or business centre, so we could confirm none of those.
organisations.pt: A câmara diz que os abriu no final de 2021. Um artigo de opinião de 2025 afirmava que Silves não tinha incubadora, aceleradora nem centro de negócios, por isso não confirmámos nenhum destes.

organisations.name: CRESC Algarve 2020 (FEDER) funding for the Celerator technology hub
organisations.what: 4 million euros of European funds in a 7.2 million euro mobility and energy technology hub beside the Autódromo, run by Parkalgar and UAlg. No AI work is stated.
organisations.pt: 4 milhões de euros de fundos europeus num polo tecnológico de mobilidade e energia de 7,2 milhões de euros junto ao Autódromo, gerido pela Parkalgar e pela UAlg.

organisations.name: CRESC Algarve 2020, funding for Sea4Us
organisations.what: About 1.3 million euros of regional programme funding reported for Sea4Us.
organisations.pt: Cerca de 1,3 milhões de euros de fundos do programa regional noticiados para a Sea4Us.

organisations.name: CRIA (UAlg entrepreneurship and technology transfer division)
organisations.what: Runs UAlg's proof-of-concept validation programme for technology projects at maturity levels 3 to 6 (June 2026 call) and the Ideias em Caixa business-idea competition, with Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP, ANJE, AMAL and NERA.
organisations.ai: Matures university technology, AI projects included, into startups.

also.what: Ran the Atlazul Guadiana business-ideas contest in Castro Marim in 2022, with the council and CCMAR on the jury. No current Castro Marim programme found.
UAlg division that runs the university's incubator and hosted the 10 November AI Lunch & Learn and, per our newsroom, the Vibathon opening.

organisations.pt: Gere o programa de validação de prova de conceito da UAlg para projetos tecnológicos e o concurso de ideias de negócio Ideias em Caixa, com a Algarve Evolution, o Algarve STP, a ANJE, a AMAL e a NERA.

organisations.name: Dengun
organisations.what: An Algarve-based company whose chief executive said in May 2026 that it plans to create 150 technology companies in the region within seven years and that the region lacks AI computing capacity. Its base city is not stated on the page we read.
organisations.ai: Argues for regional AI infrastructure.
organisations.pt: Empresa do Algarve cujo presidente executivo disse em maio de 2026 que planeia criar 150 empresas tecnológicas na região em sete anos.

organisations.name: DETAILS, Hospitality, Sports, Leisure (Arrow Global, Vilamoura)
organisations.what: Manages Arrow Global's hospitality, sports and leisure assets in Portugal, including Vilamoura's golf courses, and brought Trackman ball tracking to the Old Course in 2025.
organisations.ai: The operator of Vilamoura's courses deploys sensor and data technology, a base for analytics. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Gere os ativos de hotelaria, desporto e lazer da Arrow Global em Portugal, incluindo os campos de golfe de Vilamoura.

organisations.name: DigiATLA
organisations.what: Interreg Atlantic Area project (1 January 2026 to 30 June 2028, about EUR 2.13 million) on digital capacity and precision nutrition in aquaculture, led by S2AQUA with SPAROS, IPMA and universities in Vigo, Galway and France.
organisations.ai: Industry 4.0 and precision nutrition in fish farming, with SPAROS (AI project of its own) as a partner. The official page does not mention AI.
organisations.pt: Projeto Interreg Espaço Atlântico (2026 a 2028, cerca de 2,13 milhões de euros) sobre capacidade digital e nutrição de precisão na aquacultura, liderado pelo S2AQUA com a SPAROS, o IPMA e universidades.

organisations.name: Digital Commerce Accelerator, local actions in São Brás
organisations.what: Recovery-plan programme led by the Algarve business association, run locally under a protocol with the council.
organisations.ai: Digitising small firms is the step before they adopt AI tools.
organisations.pt: Programa do Plano de Recuperação liderado pela associação empresarial do Algarve, executado localmente com a câmara.

organisations.name: Digital-transformation grant, call ALGARVE-2025-13
organisations.what: Approved investment for the council's digital services, covering infrastructure, security, Wi-Fi and automation, with AI listed among the project areas.
organisations.ai: The grant lists AI among its project areas.
organisations.pt: Investimento aprovado para os serviços digitais da câmara (infraestrutura, segurança, Wi-Fi e automação), com a IA entre as áreas do projeto.

organisations.name: Digital-transition funding calls listed by the council
organisations.what: The council's calls page lists national funding such as Smart PME (Industry 4.0), Coaching 4.0 and vouchers for startups with green and digital products. The titles name no AI and the page gives no dates, so check each call at its source.
organisations.pt: A página de avisos da câmara lista financiamento nacional como o Smart PME (Indústria 4.0), o Coaching 4.0 e vales para startups com produtos verdes e digitais. Os títulos não referem IA e a página não indica datas, por isso confirme cada aviso na sua fonte.

organisations.name: DigitalGTPro
organisations.what: Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP company that automates business processes and supports data-driven decisions. The article gives no town.
organisations.ai: Process automation and data-driven decisions are the usual home of AI tools, and the article does not say it uses AI.
organisations.pt: Empresa do Venture Lab by AlgarveSTP que automatiza processos de negócio e apoia decisões com base em dados.

organisations.name: DRAP Algarve, Centro de Experimentação Agrária de Tavira (CEAT)
organisations.what: The regional agriculture and fisheries directorate manages the CEAT in Tavira, the site that anchors the Polo de Inovação and its Mediterranean Diet research.
organisations.ai: The public owner of the research site and its long-running crop collections, which agri-food and climate AI would draw on. The source mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: A direção regional de agricultura e pescas gere o CEAT em Tavira, o local que acolhe o Polo de Inovação e a sua investigação sobre a Dieta Mediterrânica.

organisations.name: DSPA (Data Science Portuguese Association)
organisations.what: National association for data science and AI that is listed as a member of Algarve Evolution. Its own site lists a generative AI certification, an AI Act compliance programme for businesses, an AI agents day for executives and the annual INSIGHTS conference. The site states no Algarve link: it appears on the map because of the membership.
organisations.ai: It is a national data science and AI association.
organisations.pt: Listada como membro da Algarve Evolution. A página de membros não indica descrição nem concelho: o nome sugere ciência de dados, e não confirmámos o que faz no Algarve. Precisa de fonte própria.

organisations.name: dstelecom
organisations.what: Fibre infrastructure operator extending its network in Alcoutim, Giões and Pereiro.
organisations.ai: Connectivity is the first step: no fibre or mobile link, no AI services for the village. We have not seen dstelecom offer AI products.
organisations.pt: Operador de infraestrutura de fibra que está a alargar a rede em Alcoutim, Giões e Pereiro.

organisations.name: Edifício Multifuncional de Empresas (EME), Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
organisations.what: The council's business hub with individual offices, shared spaces, meeting rooms, wireless internet and incubation support, for entrepreneurs with innovative, scalable ideas who want their headquarters in Castro Marim. The council publishes the operating regulation, an application form and an information leaflet.
organisations.pt: O centro de empresas da câmara, com escritórios, espaços partilhados, salas de reunião e apoio à incubação, para empreendedores com ideias inovadoras e escaláveis que queiram sede em Castro Marim.

organisations.name: Edit'AI
organisations.what: Publisher of the founders' book with AI prompts that was presented at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 30 September 2026.
organisations.ai: Publishes an AI-based startup method.
organisations.pt: Editora do livro de fundadores com instruções de IA apresentado no UALG TEC Campus, em Faro, a 30 de setembro de 2026.

organisations.name: EDP (solar and wind in Aljezur)
organisations.what: Operates the 24 MW Bordeira wind farm and a new 15.3 MW solar plant beside it in Aljezur.
organisations.ai: Renewable generation is the power supply that AI data centres need. No AI link in the source.
organisations.pt: Opera o parque eólico da Bordeira, de 24 MW, e uma nova central solar de 15,3 MW ao lado, em Aljezur.

organisations.name: Elevated Design
organisations.what: Algarve studio that builds websites, AI chatbots and workflow automation for local businesses, and names Lagos among the towns it serves. Its page states no Lagos office, so this is a company serving Lagos, not one confirmed based there.
organisations.ai: Sells AI chatbots and automation to Lagos businesses.
organisations.pt: Estúdio do Algarve que faz sites, chatbots de IA e automação para empresas locais e inclui Lagos entre as localidades que serve.

organisations.name: EMARP (Portimão municipal water and waste company)
organisations.what: Bought 20 AI acoustic loggers to monitor the water network for leaks and run two Fundo Ambiental leak-control projects.
organisations.ai: A utility using AI monitoring on its network.
organisations.pt: Comprou 20 sensores acústicos com IA para detetar fugas na rede de água e gere dois projetos do Fundo Ambiental.

organisations.name: Empowered Startups
organisations.what: Partner of UAlg in building an Algarve AI cluster and Platinum sponsor of the EPIA 2025 AI conference.
organisations.ai: It backs a regional AI cluster.
organisations.pt: Parceira da UAlg na criação de um cluster de IA no Algarve e patrocinadora da conferência EPIA 2025.

organisations.name: ePaper by Mind (vendor whose client logos include Loulé)
organisations.what: Mind's digital urban-planning platform. Its page shows a 'Loulé' logo among 27 municipal client logos and names AI features: document checks at online reception, an AI error check before a request is filed, and an AI agent announced on 13 October 2026. The page says nothing about what Loulé uses, and the council has not named the AI tools it contracted for planning, so we do not link the two. Found by detective.places@ and read by us on 16 November 2026.
organisations.ai: A planning platform with AI features lists Loulé's council among its clients, and the council says it uses AI tools for planning: the link is a lead, not a claim.
organisations.pt: A plataforma digital de urbanismo da Mind. A sua página mostra um logótipo de 'Loulé' entre 27 logótipos de clientes municipais e indica funções de IA: verificação de documentos no atendimento online, uma verificação de erros com IA antes de submeter um pedido e um agente de IA anunciado a 13 de outubro de 2026. A página nada diz sobre o que Loulé usa, e a câmara não indicou as ferramentas de IA que contratou para o urbanismo, por isso não ligamos as duas. Encontrada pelo detective.places@ e lida por nós a 16 de novembro de 2026.

organisations.name: Escola de Hotelaria e Turismo de Portimão
organisations.what: Hospitality school that hosted the February 2026 presentation of the AI como Copiloto book and was engaged around the TMCT conference.
organisations.ai: Hosted a public launch and debate on using generative AI at work.
organisations.pt: Escola de hotelaria que acolheu em fevereiro de 2026 a apresentação do livro AI como Copiloto.

organisations.name: Espaço Coworking São Brás de Alportel
organisations.what: Municipal coworking space for young people opened in August 2020, with five workstations and a meeting room.
organisations.ai: A seat where local founders could start tech projects. No AI use reported.
organisations.pt: Coworking municipal para jovens aberto em agosto de 2020, com cinco postos de trabalho e uma sala de reuniões.

organisations.name: Eurocidade do Guadiana (Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António, Castro Marim)
organisations.what: Cross-border grouping of three councils that presented a pilot AI avatar video for tourism in January 2024, led by Ayamonte. Castro Marim's council president took part.
organisations.ai: A grouping that includes Castro Marim used generative AI for tourism promotion.

also.what: Cross-border grouping of Ayamonte, Castro Marim and Vila Real de Santo António, named European Sport Community 2026. VRSA's council holds its presidency this year.

organisations.pt: Agrupamento transfronteiriço de três câmaras que apresentou em janeiro de 2024 um vídeo piloto com um avatar de IA para o turismo.

organisations.name: European funds behind SPIC's AI.EVENT
organisations.what: RTP says SPIC's AI platform for reading audience reactions has had European funding. It names no programme or amount.
organisations.ai: The grant funds an AI product.
organisations.pt: A RTP diz que a plataforma de IA da SPIC para ler as reações do público teve financiamento europeu, sem indicar programa nem montante.

organisations.name: European Innovation Council Accelerator, investment in Sea4Us
organisations.what: About 5.6 million euros from the EIC Accelerator for the Sagres marine biotech company, as reported by Barlavento in December 2023.
organisations.ai: Candidate only: marine drug discovery, no AI use stated in the source.
organisations.pt: Cerca de 5,6 milhões de euros do EIC Accelerator para a empresa de biotecnologia marinha de Sagres, segundo o Barlavento em dezembro de 2023.

organisations.name: expressTEC
organisations.what: Faro biotech startup spun out of UAlg research, building an RNA-based test to guide cancer therapy, with machine-learning software that produces the clinical report.
organisations.ai: A machine-learning product at the core of its test (the source is sponsored content).
organisations.pt: Startup de biotecnologia de Faro nascida da investigação da UAlg, que desenvolve um teste baseado em RNA para orientar a terapia do cancro.

organisations.name: Fábrica do Empreendedor de Lagos
organisations.what: Free support for entrepreneurs, companies and individuals (employment, training, starting a business), promoted by the social entrepreneurs agency SEA with the Lagos council as social investor. Its Lagos office moved to the marina area in 2021. Also a partner of DevFest Lagos 2025.
organisations.ai: Partner of an AI-themed developer conference, and the council's main route for a founder to start a business.
organisations.pt: Apoio gratuito a empreendedores, empresas e particulares (emprego, formação, criar um negócio), promovido pela agência SEA com a Câmara de Lagos como investidora social.

organisations.name: Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia (FCT-UAlg)
organisations.what: UAlg faculty named as the contact for EPIA 2025, the 24th Portuguese conference on AI, held at the Gambelas campus in Faro on 1 to 3 October 2025.
organisations.ai: It hosted a national AI conference.
organisations.pt: Faculdade da UAlg que foi o contacto da EPIA 2025, a 24.ª conferência portuguesa de IA, no campus de Gambelas, em Faro, de 1 a 3 de outubro de 2025.

organisations.name: Faro council: business incubation (a business nest managed by ANJE)
organisations.what: Spaces for microenterprises and emerging projects of young entrepreneurs. The page names no services, price, sector or application channel, and points to IEFP and CRIA at the University of Algarve.
organisations.pt: Espaços para microempresas e projetos emergentes de jovens empreendedores. A página remete para o IEFP e para o CRIA da Universidade do Algarve.

organisations.name: Faro council: Desenvolvimento económico (Faro Invest)
organisations.what: The council's economic development desk lists technological and business innovation as a priority and names spin-offs from the University of Algarve, strategic and individual investors and service entrepreneurs as its audiences. Meetings are by appointment.
organisations.pt: O gabinete de desenvolvimento económico da câmara, com a inovação tecnológica e empresarial como prioridade, para spin-offs da UAlg, investidores e empreendedores. Reuniões por marcação.

organisations.name: Flow Productions
organisations.what: Organised the July 2026 hybrid panel at UALG TEC Campus on AI search and company visibility, with Algarve STP.
organisations.ai: Convenes business audiences on AI search.

also.what: Creative technology agency with teams in Faro and Lisbon, listed as a member of Algarve Evolution (as Flow With Us). Its services include MarTech and AI, and its site says it helps companies get found by people and AI engines. It organised the July 2026 Faro panel on how AI assistants recommend businesses.

organisations.pt: Organizou em julho de 2026 o painel híbrido no UALG TEC Campus sobre pesquisa com IA e visibilidade das empresas, com o Algarve STP.

organisations.name: FMCB-UAlg (Faculty of Medicine and Biomedical Sciences)
organisations.what: Co-runs the executive course on AI in healthcare with AuroraMed, held in Faro.
organisations.ai: It co-teaches an AI in healthcare course.
organisations.pt: Coorganiza com a AuroraMed o curso executivo de IA na saúde, em Faro.

organisations.name: Fosteam@South, Recovery and Resilience funding for the Sagres marine laboratory
organisations.what: About 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience Plan money for the Universidade do Algarve, CCMAR and municipality marine biology laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, as reported in June 2023.
organisations.pt: Cerca de 2,1 milhões de euros do Plano de Recuperação e Resiliência para o laboratório de biologia marinha da UAlg, do CCMAR e do município no Porto da Baleeira.

organisations.name: FULGUR-IT
organisations.what: Technology-based company in Olhão with solutions for agriculture, industry and smart cities, per its Portugal 2020 funding record for an internationalisation diagnosis.
organisations.ai: Sensor and smart-city platforms generate the data that AI analytics runs on. We found no claim of AI in its own products: a weak, 3-step entry kept until its site is read.
organisations.pt: Empresa de base tecnológica em Olhão com soluções para agricultura, indústria e cidades inteligentes.

organisations.name: Fundacao Galp (Vilas em Movimento)
organisations.what: Social investment in Alcoutim's shared electric bikes, with the Odiana association and the council.
organisations.ai: The bikes run on a digital platform that produces usage data, a third-step link to AI.
organisations.amount: more than 100,000 euros for the bike system
organisations.pt: Investimento social nas bicicletas elétricas partilhadas de Alcoutim, com a associação Odiana e a câmara.

organisations.name: Fundo Ambiental, EMARP leak-control projects
organisations.what: Funds two leak-detection projects of the municipal water company, including the AI acoustic loggers.
organisations.ai: Pays for AI-driven leak monitoring.
organisations.pt: Financia dois projetos de deteção de fugas da empresa municipal de águas, incluindo os sensores acústicos com IA.

organisations.name: Gabinete de Empreendedorismo (council business desk)
organisations.what: Created January 2022. Prepares funding applications for businesses and public bodies, tracks funding lines, prepares feasibility studies and supports investors.
organisations.pt: Criado em janeiro de 2022. Prepara candidaturas a financiamento para empresas e entidades públicas, acompanha linhas de financiamento, prepara estudos de viabilidade e apoia investidores.

organisations.name: GDG Faro
organisations.what: Independent, community-run developer meetup in Faro. Runs DevFest 2026 and ran an AI hackathon on Gemma on 18 July 2026.
organisations.ai: Its events are about building with AI.

also.what: Developer community that organises DevFest Faro on 27 and 28 November 2026 on AI applications and agents. Its pages also list a Build with AI 2026 day on 11 April and a Gemma AI hackathon on 18 July at UALG TEC Campus, both still marked upcoming when read, so we cannot confirm they ran.

organisations.pt: Comunidade de programadores independente em Faro. Organiza o DevFest 2026 e fez um hackathon de IA a 18 de julho de 2026.

organisations.name: GDG Lagos (Google Developer Group)
organisations.what: Runs AI talks and workshops at The Collab Bar and the Town Hall, including Build with AI, an agents talk and DevFest Lagos.
organisations.ai: Its programme is largely about AI, agents and building with AI.
organisations.pt: Organiza palestras e workshops de IA no The Collab Bar e nos Paços do Concelho, incluindo o Build with AI e o DevFest Lagos.

organisations.name: Geek Girls Faro
organisations.what: Faro chapter of Geek Girls Portugal, which held an event in 2019 on women in AI and tech. We found nothing newer.
organisations.ai: A tech community that has put women in AI on its programme.
organisations.pt: Núcleo de Faro das Geek Girls Portugal, que em 2019 fez um evento sobre mulheres na IA e na tecnologia. Não encontrámos nada mais recente.

organisations.name: GEL, the council's local entrepreneurship office
organisations.what: Informs entrepreneurs about support, links them to public or private institutions, advises on the rules for EU and other funding, and helps local producers.
organisations.pt: Informa os empreendedores sobre apoios, liga-os a instituições públicas ou privadas, aconselha sobre as regras do financiamento europeu e outro, e ajuda os produtores locais.

organisations.name: Guepardo
organisations.what: Listed by the StartUP Portimão incubator as developing V2X (vehicle-to-everything) and AI products to improve road mobility and traffic coordination. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni. We found no independent reporting on its products, funding or deployments.
organisations.ai: Builds AI and V2X products, as the incubator describes it.
organisations.pt: Listada pela incubadora StartUP Portimão como empresa que desenvolve produtos V2X e de IA para a mobilidade rodoviária. Não encontrámos notícias independentes sobre os seus produtos.

organisations.name: Horizon 2020 SME Instrument phase 1, Sea4Pain feasibility study
organisations.what: EU contribution of 50,000 euros (total cost 71,429 euros) to Sea4Us for a feasibility study, 1 May to 30 September 2018.
organisations.pt: Contribuição europeia de 50.000 euros à Sea4Us para um estudo de viabilidade, em 2018.

organisations.name: Horizon Europe, Teaming for Excellence (European Commission) into UAlgTec Heritage
organisations.what: 15 million euros of the 31.5 million euro package for the University of Algarve's archaeology centre ICArEHB.
organisations.ai: Funds a centre that will use AI on archaeological heritage: directly about AI.
organisations.pt: 15 milhões de euros do pacote de 31,5 milhões para o centro de arqueologia ICArEHB da Universidade do Algarve.

organisations.name: ICArEHB (UAlg research centre)
organisations.what: UAlg archaeology research centre behind UAlgTec Heritage, funded with 31.5 million euros to use AI in heritage protection.
organisations.ai: Will apply AI to risk forecasting and decision support for archaeological sites.

also.what: UAlg research centre in archaeology and human behaviour evolution. It leads UAlgTec Heritage, which won 31.5 million euros to create UAlgTec Heritage, a European centre taking an AI-first approach to heritage. A presentation is listed for 17 November 2026 in Faro.

organisations.pt: Centro de investigação em arqueologia da UAlg por trás do UAlgTec Heritage, financiado com 31,5 milhões de euros para usar IA na proteção do património.

organisations.name: Ideias em Caixa (UAlg and CRIA)
organisations.what: Business-idea competition: 40 ideas get maturation sessions and the top idea in each of eight categories wins 5,000 euros. Open to over 18s and firms under three years old (8th edition, 2024 to 2025).
organisations.pt: Concurso de ideias de negócio: 40 ideias recebem sessões de maturação e a melhor de cada uma das oito categorias ganha 5.000 euros (8.ª edição, 2024 a 2025).

organisations.name: Incubadora de Empresas de Monchique (IEM)
organisations.what: The municipal business incubator, listed by the council among its co-financed projects (Vale incubadoras e aceleradoras). It hosts Invisible CFO and says it aims to attract and support companies that settle in Monchique and create jobs.
organisations.ai: It hosts an AI-using startup, so it is the place where an AI company in Monchique would most likely start.

also.what: Individual, accompanied support for local entrepreneurs, online follow-up sessions and signposting to open funding calls. Pre-registration at the Espaço Jovem next to the Monchique parish council. No AI programme is named.

organisations.pt: A incubadora municipal de empresas, que acolhe a Invisible CFO e quer atrair e apoiar empresas que se instalem em Monchique e criem emprego.

organisations.name: InovaPrime
organisations.what: Local information technology company that presented its activity at the council's sixth business ideas forum on 27 October 2026.
organisations.ai: An IT company is a natural place for AI services to be built or resold. The council page gives no product detail and does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check.
organisations.pt: Empresa local de tecnologias de informação que apresentou a sua atividade no sexto fórum de ideias de negócio da câmara, a 27 de outubro de 2026.

organisations.name: Instituto Politécnico de Beja, partner of the Lagoa air quality work
organisations.what: Based in Beja, not in Lagoa: listed because its teachers plan a scientific paper with Lagoa council as institutional partner.
organisations.ai: Supervised the AI prototype and plans to publish it with Lagoa as partner.
organisations.pt: Sediado em Beja, não em Lagoa: listado porque os seus docentes preparam um artigo científico com a Câmara de Lagoa como parceira.

organisations.name: Instituto Superior Tecnico (Robotics4Farmers partner)
organisations.what: Lisbon engineering school, a named partner of the Robotics4Farmers consortium that includes Alcoutim's council. Not based in Alcoutim.
organisations.ai: It is a partner in a project built on AI-guided cameras and learning algorithms.
organisations.pt: Escola de engenharia de Lisboa, parceira do consórcio Robotics4Farmers, que inclui a Câmara de Alcoutim. Não está sediado em Alcoutim.

organisations.name: International Sci-Tech Innovation Competition (information session at UALG TEC Campus, 21 July 2026)
organisations.what: A China and Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries contest with prizes up to about 25 million euros across 100 projects, run by two chambers of commerce with Algarve Evolution. Winners can reach over 50 investment funds in the Greater Bay Area. No deadline stated.
organisations.pt: Concurso entre a China e os países de língua portuguesa e espanhola, com prémios até cerca de 25 milhões de euros em 100 projetos, organizado por duas câmaras de comércio com a Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: Interreg Spain-Portugal and FEDER in Agrosocial Plus
organisations.what: Cross-border funding of the project in which Odiana represents the Lower Guadiana and Living Labs will test AI and IoT.
organisations.ai: The Living Labs are planned to test AI directly. The sum is for the whole project, not for Alcoutim.
organisations.amount: 1,546,822.39 euros of 2,062,429.85 euros in total, for the whole project
organisations.pt: Financiamento transfronteiriço do projeto em que a Odiana representa o Baixo Guadiana e onde laboratórios vivos vão testar IA e IoT.

organisations.name: INTREPIDA pro
organisations.what: Cross-border Interreg Spain-Portugal project led by Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, with NERA as partner. It supported the 10 November Lunch & Learn on AI tools in Faro.
organisations.ai: It runs sessions on using AI tools in business.
organisations.pt: Projeto transfronteiriço Interreg Espanha-Portugal liderado pela Fundación Tres Culturas del Mediterráneo, com a NERA como parceira. Apoiou o Lunch & Learn sobre ferramentas de IA, em Faro, a 10 de novembro.

organisations.name: Invisible CFO
organisations.what: Portuguese fintech founded in 2024 and based in Monchique, a digital finance provider for small businesses and freelancers. By its own account it combines AI, automation and a human team, and says 300,000 euros of EU funding helped develop its AI and automation applications. Named an Impact Startup 2025.
organisations.ai: Its product uses AI directly in financial and tax optimisation.
organisations.pt: Fintech portuguesa fundada em 2024 e sediada em Monchique, que ajuda pequenas empresas nas finanças com algoritmos, IA e uma equipa de consultores. Distinguida como Impact Startup 2025.

organisations.name: IPMA, Estação Piloto de Piscicultura de Olhão (EPPO)
organisations.what: National pilot fish-farming station at Marim in the Ria Formosa Natural Park, for research, pilot-scale demonstration and technology transfer to industry.
organisations.ai: Hosts the lab where AI and digital aquaculture research is tested. Its page mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: Estação piloto nacional de piscicultura em Marim, na Ria Formosa, para investigação, demonstração à escala piloto e transferência de tecnologia para a indústria.

organisations.name: ISMAT, Instituto Superior Manuel Teixeira Gomes
organisations.what: Higher-education institution in Portimão run by COFAC. Its computer engineering degree has a 6 ECTS Inteligência Artificial unit in the third year.
organisations.ai: Teaches AI as part of a computing degree.
organisations.pt: Instituição de ensino superior em Portimão, gerida pela COFAC. A licenciatura em engenharia informática tem uma unidade de Inteligência Artificial no terceiro ano.

organisations.name: JFA Training
organisations.what: Training and consulting firm applying the Kaizen method, listed in the StartUP Portimão incubator. Two speakers from it appeared on the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel. The incubator's list is undated (its footer says 2023) and does not separate current residents from alumni.
organisations.ai: A training firm from the incubator that spoke on a local AI panel.
organisations.pt: Empresa de formação e consultoria com o método Kaizen, listada na incubadora StartUP Portimão.

organisations.name: Junior Achievement Portugal
organisations.what: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

partner.note: Runs 'The Company' with Algarve Evolution's education work.

organisations.pt: Dinamiza o programa 'A Empresa' no trabalho de educação da Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Aljezur
organisations.what: The parish council that launched the Gota Aljezur teleassistance pilot with Tecnologias Imaginadas.
organisations.ai: A public body adopting health technology, a first step toward AI services.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia que lançou o piloto de teleassistência Gota Aljezur com a Tecnologias Imaginadas.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Ferragudo
organisations.what: The parish council runs Ferrukas, an AI virtual assistant on its website, and an official app. A PRR-funded digital neighbourhood project is under way in the village.
organisations.ai: Operates an AI assistant for citizens.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia tem a Ferrukas, uma assistente virtual com IA no seu site, e uma aplicação oficial.

organisations.name: Junta de Freguesia de Quarteira
organisations.what: The parish council of Quarteira, a partner in the digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: A junta de freguesia de Quarteira, parceira do consórcio do bairro comercial digital.

organisations.name: Jupiter Hotel Group (Jupiter Albufeira Hotel)
organisations.what: A hotel group with a hotel in Albufeira that the vendor Quinta lists as a user of its AI guest communication app.
organisations.ai: Hotel group uses an AI guest-messaging app, named by the vendor.
organisations.pt: Grupo hoteleiro com um hotel em Albufeira que o fornecedor Quinta indica como utilizador da sua aplicação de comunicação com hóspedes com IA.

organisations.name: KIPT CoLab
organisations.what: Consortium partner in INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. Its own role in AI is not yet sourced.
organisations.ai: It is a partner of the AI and robotics tourism programme.
organisations.pt: Parceiro do consórcio INOVA ALGARVE 3.0. O seu papel na IA ainda não tem fonte.

organisations.name: KTTSeaDrones (cross-border Spain and Portugal project, with a Sagres pilot)
organisations.what: A POCTEP research project on aerial and aquatic drones and fixed sensors for marine and fisheries science, led by the Universidad de Huelva, with CCMAR and CINTAL as Algarve partners and a pilot at Sagres. A search result describing its technical report says its software layer used computer vision and AI to detect fish. We could not open the report (it returned errors), so the AI claim is unverified.
organisations.ai: Reported by a search summary of the project's technical report: computer vision and AI models to identify fish in video. To be confirmed by opening the report. Path: marine monitoring project, then its fish detection software, which is AI.
organisations.pt: Projeto de investigação POCTEP sobre drones aéreos e aquáticos e sensores para a ciência marinha e das pescas, liderado pela Universidad de Huelva, com o CCMAR e o CINTAL como parceiros no Algarve e um piloto em Sagres.

organisations.name: Lagos Digital Nomads
organisations.what: Started by a local entrepreneur in 2020 or 2021 during the pandemic, it links the town's digital nomads with local businesses through a website, networking events and workshops. Media partner of the Women's Day AI event.
organisations.ai: Media partner of an AI event, and a community of remote workers who are a likely audience for AI tools.
organisations.pt: Criada por um empresário local durante a pandemia, liga os nómadas digitais da cidade às empresas locais com um site, eventos e workshops.

organisations.name: Lagos Remoters
organisations.what: A community of Lagos remote workers, listed as a partner and media partner of the International Women's Day Build with AI event.
organisations.ai: Partner of an AI and business event, and a pool of remote workers who attend such events.
organisations.pt: Uma comunidade de trabalhadores remotos de Lagos, parceira do evento Build with AI do Dia Internacional da Mulher.

organisations.name: LeiGPT
organisations.what: AI platform for lawyers on Portuguese law, registered in Faro and a member of Algarve Evolution, which its site lists with Google for Startups and Akamai among its partners and supporters. It answers legal research questions with citations to codes and court rulings, analyses documents, and runs as a cloud service or on a client's own servers. Available now, with a free one-day trial.
organisations.ai: Its product is an AI assistant for legal work.
organisations.pt: Plataforma de IA para advogados sobre direito português, registada em Faro e membro da Algarve Evolution, cujo site indica a Google for Startups e a Akamai entre os seus parceiros e apoiantes. Responde a perguntas de pesquisa jurídica com citações de códigos e decisões judiciais, analisa documentos e funciona como serviço na nuvem ou nos servidores do próprio cliente. Já disponível, com um dia de teste gratuito.

organisations.name: Liceu Azul
organisations.what: New school project in Aljezur with secondary education in Sciences and Technologies, due to open in September 2026, with a research centre on innovative teaching.
organisations.ai: Science and technology education is the start of a local pipeline toward AI skills. No AI teaching is claimed.
organisations.pt: Novo projeto de escola em Aljezur com ensino secundário em Ciências e Tecnologias, com abertura prevista para setembro de 2026.

organisations.name: LOFT Community
organisations.what: Community of remote workers, digital nomads and entrepreneurs across Loulé, Olhão, Faro and Tavira. Its collaborators include Algarve Evolution, Tavira Works, GDG, the Algarve Blockchain Community, GeekSessions and the 351 Startup Association. No AI event is listed on its page.
organisations.ai: A tech-adjacent community whose collaborators run developer and startup events where AI is a topic. The page lists no AI-specific event.
organisations.pt: Comunidade de trabalhadores remotos, nómadas digitais e empreendedores em Loulé, Olhão, Faro e Tavira. Entre os colaboradores estão a Algarve Evolution, a Tavira Works, o GDG, a Algarve Blockchain Community, as GeekSessions e a 351 Startup Association. A sua página não lista eventos de IA.

organisations.name: Loulé and Faro multi-technology centre, Estádio Algarve (planned)
organisations.what: A tendered centre of about 2,235 square metres for companies and startups. Proposals were due on 2 November 2026 and the work has 12 months to run.
organisations.pt: Centro em concurso de cerca de 2.235 metros quadrados para empresas e startups. As propostas terminaram a 2 de novembro de 2026 e a obra tem 12 meses.

organisations.name: Loulé Concelho Global
organisations.what: Named as a partner in the Quarteira digital commercial neighbourhood consortium.
organisations.ai: Partner in the PRR Digital Commercial Neighbourhood of Quarteira, which brings shops online and adds digital displays and Wi-Fi: the digital base for retail AI. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Parceiro do consórcio do bairro comercial digital de Quarteira.

organisations.name: Loulé Design Lab (Loulé Criativo)
organisations.what: Municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI programme found yet.
organisations.ai: A municipal incubator where AI startups could land: the lab, then its startups.

also.what: The municipal creative and technology incubator and coworking space.

organisations.pt: Incubadora municipal criativa e tecnológica e espaço de coworking, segundo o BeAlgarve.

organisations.name: Lovable
organisations.what: AI app-building company whose tool powered the sold-out Vibathon Algarve of 31 October 2026, co-organised with Algarve Evolution (per our newsroom).
organisations.ai: Its AI tool was the core of the event.
organisations.pt: Empresa de criação de aplicações com IA cuja ferramenta foi usada no Vibathon Algarve, esgotado, a 31 de outubro de 2026, coorganizado com a Algarve Evolution.

organisations.name: MARREAL underwater observatory, Sagres (UAlg, CINTAL, CCMAR, INESC-TEC)
organisations.what: An observatory installed in October 2022 at about 20 metres depth off Sagres, with an underwater video camera, a temperature and salinity sensor, a particle sensor and an underwater noise sensor. It records data in real time, to be put online. An initiative of the Tec4Sea research infrastructure, with the KTTSeaDrones project joining.
organisations.ai: Video and acoustic data streams are the raw material for automatic detection of fish and sounds. The article itself does not mention AI, so the link is unconfirmed. Path: ocean observatory, then its video and sound data, then AI analysis.
organisations.pt: Observatório instalado em outubro de 2022 a cerca de 20 metros de profundidade ao largo de Sagres, com câmara de vídeo e sensores, que regista dados em tempo real.

organisations.name: Mentors and partner network of StartUP Portimão
organisations.what: In 2022 the incubator reported more than 40 mentors, more than 45 partner entities and 25 startups hosted. Its site has sections for national and local partners, an advisory board and mentors.
