organisations.pt: Em 2022 a incubadora indicava mais de 40 mentores, mais de 45 entidades parceiras e 25 startups acolhidas.

organisations.name: Mind (ePaper)
organisations.what: Portuguese software vendor whose ePaper urban planning system is going into Castro Marim. It also markets an AI agent, Agente ePaper IA, that answers planning questions in natural language, reported on its own news page on 13 October 2026.
organisations.ai: Vendor of an AI agent product and of the AI-ready software the council is adopting. Not based in Castro Marim as far as we saw, listed because it supplies the town.
organisations.pt: Empresa portuguesa de software cujo sistema de urbanismo ePaper está a ser implementado em Castro Marim. Também comercializa um agente de IA que responde a perguntas de urbanismo.

organisations.name: Modernizacao e Digitalizacao do Municipio de Alcoutim (Algarve 2030 project)
organisations.what: Council project to strengthen IT infrastructure and cybersecurity, digitise internal processes, open online services and train staff, due 30 June 2028.
organisations.ai: Digital records and online services are the groundwork for any later AI in the council's services. No AI is mentioned.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara para reforçar a infraestrutura informática e a cibersegurança, digitalizar processos internos, abrir serviços online e formar trabalhadores, com conclusão prevista a 30 de junho de 2028.

organisations.name: MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
organisations.what: UAlg spin-off founded in October 2019 and based at UALG TEC Campus. Sensors and a web app switch off hotel room air conditioning when a window opens or a room is empty. Backed by Portugal Ventures.
organisations.ai: Its origin was a research project using AI algorithms, but the 2022 article does not say how the product uses AI now.
organisations.pt: Spin-off da UAlg fundada em 2019 e sediada no UALG TEC Campus. Sensores e uma aplicação web desligam o ar condicionado dos quartos de hotel quando uma janela abre ou o quarto está vazio.

organisations.name: Municipal tax exemptions for innovative or creative investment
organisations.what: The council says it has granted tax exemptions since at least mid-2017 to investment projects such as innovative or creative activities, job creation, local products and energy efficiency.
organisations.pt: A câmara diz que concede isenções fiscais desde pelo menos meados de 2017 a projetos de investimento como atividades inovadoras ou criativas, criação de emprego, produtos locais e eficiência energética.

organisations.name: Município de Albufeira
organisations.what: The council says it uses an AI-based urban management platform, and it runs a smart city portal for occurrence management.
organisations.ai: The council says it uses AI in urban processes.
organisations.pt: A câmara diz usar uma plataforma de gestão urbana com IA e tem um portal de cidade inteligente para gestão de ocorrências.

organisations.name: Municipio de Alcoutim
organisations.what: The council's published general office channel and opening hours.

contacts.label: Municipio de Alcoutim: official general channel
contacts.channel: The council's general email and telephone, with opening hours Monday to Friday 8:30 to 15:00, are published in the footer of the linked page. Shown here as a link, not copied: the gate still rejects a literal address.

organisations.pt: Os contactos gerais publicados pela câmara e o horário de atendimento.

organisations.name: Municipio de Aljezur
organisations.what: The council runs an online services portal, an interactive municipal map, a GEO Portal and a tourist app. We found no AI use.
organisations.ai: Digital services and geodata are the base on which AI assistants and analysis would sit. Nothing AI found yet.

contacts.label: Município de Aljezur, general channel (Contactos úteis page)
contacts.channel: geral@cm-aljezur.pt, +351 282 990 010 (a call to the national fixed-line network), as published on the council's Contactos úteis page. Paços do Concelho, Rua Capitão Salgueiro Maia, 8670-005 Aljezur.

organisations.pt: A câmara tem um portal de serviços online, um mapa municipal interativo, um GEO Portal e uma aplicação turística. Não encontrámos uso de IA.

organisations.name: Município de Lagoa, SmartCity:Lagoa
organisations.what: The council runs a Smart City portal and an AI air quality prototype built with a polytechnic student, and its IT coordinator has spoken publicly about AI limits in local government.
organisations.ai: Uses an AI model for air quality forecasts.
organisations.pt: A câmara tem um portal Smart City e um protótipo de qualidade do ar com IA criado com um estudante do politécnico.

organisations.name: Município de São Brás de Alportel
organisations.what: Local council, partner in the Algarve 6.0 smart territory project, supporter of University of Algarve research, host of the town's entrepreneurship programme.
organisations.ai: Runs the urban management platform data base and funded an AI workshop.
organisations.pt: Câmara municipal, parceira do projeto de território inteligente Algarve 6.0, apoiante da investigação da Universidade do Algarve e anfitriã do programa de empreendedorismo local.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, digitalisation of municipal services
organisations.what: The council's own project sheet (approved 9 October 2025, running 1 July 2022 to 31 December 2027): strengthen the technology and network infrastructure for more capacity and reliability, described as technological modernisation and digital transformation of local administration. Eligible cost 1,072,637.94 euros, EU support 643,582.75 euros.
organisations.ai: Not AI itself. A council's digital backbone is what any later AI service for residents would run on. Path: municipal network and digital services, then AI services on top. No AI use is stated.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara (2022 a 2027) para reforçar a infraestrutura tecnológica e de rede, com um custo elegível de 1.072.637,94 euros e apoio europeu de 643.582,75 euros.

organisations.name: Municipio de Vila do Bispo, smart urban waste management
organisations.what: The council's project sheet (approved 21 November 2025, 1 June 2024 to 31 December 2025): reinforce and optimise separate waste collection, with efficiency, 'intelligent' waste management and bio-waste collection. Eligible cost 439,725 euros, EU support 263,835 euros.
organisations.ai: Weak. The sheet says intelligent management but does not mention AI or sensors. Path: smart waste collection, then data-driven routing, then AI. Unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Projeto da câmara (2024 a 2025) para reforçar e otimizar a recolha seletiva de resíduos, com um custo elegível de 439.725 euros e apoio europeu de 263.835 euros.

organisations.name: Nautiber, Estaleiros Navais do Guadiana
organisations.what: Shipyard on the Guadiana in Vila Real de Santo António. In 2021 it launched the 19 metre research vessel «Mar Profundo» for INESC TEC and CINTAL (University of Algarve), meant for testing marine robots, sensors and unmanned underwater vehicles. In December 2025 it said it plans a defence unit aimed at unmanned systems, with the structure of four surface drones already delivered, and the site undecided between VRSA, Portimão and Lagos. Visited in February 2026 as part of the council's blue economy push.
organisations.ai: It builds the hulls and structures of robots and drones, the platforms on which autonomy and AI run. The articles mention no AI.
organisations.pt: Estaleiro no Guadiana, em Vila Real de Santo António. Em 2021 lançou o navio de investigação «Mar Profundo», de 19 metros, para testar robôs marinhos e veículos subaquáticos.

organisations.name: Neomarca
organisations.what: SME consultancy operating since 1995 with its head office in Faro and a team in Porto, and a member of Algarve Evolution. Its digital transformation work includes a service called digitalisation and adoption of artificial intelligence, alongside funding advice for programmes such as PRR and Portugal 2030.
organisations.ai: It consults small firms on adopting AI tools and on the funding that pays for it.
organisations.pt: Consultora de PME em atividade desde 1995, com sede em Faro e uma equipa no Porto, e membro da Algarve Evolution. O seu trabalho de transformação digital inclui um serviço de digitalização e adoção de inteligência artificial, a par de aconselhamento sobre financiamento de programas como o PRR e o Portugal 2030.

organisations.name: NERA, Associação Empresarial da Região do Algarve
organisations.what: Regional business association headquartered in Loulé. It leads the Inova Algarve 3.0 consortium and runs AI tool training sessions and courses in November 2026.

Regional business association based in Loulé. Leads INOVA ALGARVE 3.0, runs an AI Social Content Lab course in November 2026 and hosted the AI Lunch & Learn.

organisations.name: NILG.AI (partner of ALGAR)
organisations.what: Start-up incubated at UPTEC, the University of Porto's science park, that co-built ALGAR's AI recycling-point tool. Not a Loulé firm: it is listed as ALGAR's partner.

organisations.what: Municipal incubation space in the village square, with one individual office, three coworking desks, two spaces for digital nomads and a meeting room.
organisations.ai: A shared workplace where remote tech workers and local founders could build with AI. No AI use reported.
organisations.pt: Espaço municipal de incubação na praça da vila, com um escritório individual, três postos de coworking, dois espaços para nómadas digitais e uma sala de reuniões.

organisations.name: Ninho de Empresas de Loulé (IEFP)
organisations.what: Public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve lists it. No AI tenants found yet.
organisations.ai: A technology incubator where AI startups could land: the incubator, then its startups.

also.what: A public business and technology incubator, as BeAlgarve's directory classes it.

organisations.pt: Incubadora pública de empresas e tecnologia, segundo o BeAlgarve.

organisations.name: Nobel Algarve British International School
organisations.what: A school in Lagoa that was the venue and a partner of the Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, a two-day AI hackathon for students aged 12 to 18, on 21 and 22 February 2026.
organisations.ai: Hosted an AI design hackathon for teenagers with Algarve Evolution and Algarve Tech Hub.
organisations.pt: Escola em Lagoa que acolheu o Lagoa Teens AI Design Sprint, um hackathon de IA de dois dias para alunos dos 12 aos 18 anos, em fevereiro de 2026.

organisations.name: NOVA IMS and the Lagos council smart cities protocol
organisations.what: A three-year protocol signed in September 2021 for smart-city research and data management. The article does not mention AI.
organisations.ai: Data management and smart-city research is the base for AI services, but no AI is named, so this is context only.
organisations.pt: Protocolo de três anos assinado em setembro de 2021 para investigação em cidades inteligentes e gestão de dados.

organisations.name: NOVA LINCS, UAlg pole (engineering laboratory, Campus da Penha)
organisations.what: A UAlg research centre in Faro. A November 2025 call for a one-year research grant starting in January 2026 places the work there, on the AI.INSIGHTS project (AI-powered real-time anonymous user monitoring), funded by Algarve FEDER, seeking computer vision and AI skills.
organisations.ai: Runs an AI research project in Faro.
organisations.pt: Um centro de investigação da UAlg em Faro. Um aviso de novembro de 2025 para uma bolsa de investigação de um ano, com início em janeiro de 2026, situa ali o trabalho, no projeto AI.INSIGHTS (monitorização anónima de utilizadores em tempo real com IA), financiado pelo Algarve FEDER, procurando competências em visão computacional e IA.

organisations.name: Odiana, Baixo Guadiana development association
organisations.what: Association that represents the Baixo Guadiana in the cooperation network of Agrosocial Plus, a 2,062,429.85 euro Interreg Spain-Portugal project, funded 75 percent by ERDF, whose Living Labs will test AI, IoT and smart irrigation. The article does not say whether Vila Real de Santo António is part of the project.
organisations.ai: Its project tests AI in Living Labs, with the town's link to it unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Associação que representa o Baixo Guadiana na rede de cooperação do Agrosocial Plus, um projeto Interreg Espanha-Portugal de 2.062.429,85 euros, financiado a 75 por cento pelo FEDER, cujos Living Labs vão testar IA, IoT e rega inteligente. O artigo não diz se Vila Real de Santo António faz parte do projeto.

organisations.name: Parkalgar
organisations.what: Manages the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve in Portimão, is a member of the Celerator technology park association with the University of Algarve, and was engaged around the TMCT conference.
organisations.ai: Engaged around a Portimão conference with AI sessions, and part of a technology-park association.
organisations.pt: Gere o Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, em Portimão, e é membro da associação do parque tecnológico Celerator com a Universidade do Algarve.

organisations.name: Peanuts
organisations.what: Local marketing and digital content project on the council's entrepreneur showcase (page 4 of 4).
organisations.ai: Digital marketing and content work is where AI writing and image tools are adopted first. The page does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check.
organisations.pt: Projeto local de marketing e conteúdos digitais na montra de empreendedores da câmara.

organisations.name: Pitch & Match
organisations.what: A session at StartUP Portimão's ninth anniversary on 10 August 2026 meant to connect entrepreneurs, business people, mentors and potential investors. No investor organisation is named in the report.
organisations.pt: Sessão no nono aniversário da StartUP Portimão, a 10 de agosto de 2026, para ligar empreendedores, empresários, mentores e potenciais investidores.

organisations.name: Polo de Inovação de Tavira
organisations.what: Research, innovation and technology-transfer hub on the Mediterranean Diet, health, sustainable food and climate adaptation, funded by the PRR (1.36 million euros, 3 January 2022 to 31 December 2025), with the CCDR Algarve as direct beneficiary. It includes lab equipment and a collection of about 700 fruit and grape varieties. At its November 2021 launch it had 23 partners, among them DRAP Algarve, the Município de Tavira, Ciência Viva, the Algarve Biomedical Center and Johns Hopkins University, and plans for a digital therapeutics centre and virtual-reality training.
organisations.ai: The launch plans include a digital therapeutics centre with Johns Hopkins and the Algarve Biomedical Center, a data-heavy health field where AI is the usual next step. Neither source mentions AI, and whether the centre was built is unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Polo de investigação, inovação e transferência de tecnologia sobre a Dieta Mediterrânica, saúde, alimentação sustentável e adaptação climática, financiado pelo PRR (1,36 milhões de euros, de 3 de janeiro de 2022 a 31 de dezembro de 2025), com a CCDR Algarve como beneficiária direta. Inclui equipamento de laboratório e uma coleção de cerca de 700 variedades de fruta e uva.

organisations.name: Portimão Cowork Space
organisations.what: Council coworking space whose entrepreneurs were expected at the June 2026 Future Business Summit AI panel.
organisations.ai: A local entrepreneur community that took part in an AI-themed business event.

also.what: A council shared workspace open to people and organisations with an idea, project or business that adds value to the local economy, with a continued regime and a daily regime, each with its own form and operating rules.

organisations.pt: Coworking da câmara cujos empreendedores eram esperados no painel de IA da Future Business Summit, em junho de 2026.

organisations.pt: Apoio europeu de 643.582,75 euros ao Município de Vila do Bispo, num custo elegível de 1.072.637,94 euros.

organisations.pt: Apoio europeu de 263.835 euros ao Município de Vila do Bispo, num custo elegível de 439.725 euros.

organisations.ai: A UAlg spin-off whose research project used AI algorithms: one step from AI.
organisations.pt: Investiu mais de meio milhão de euros na MTI, spin-off da UAlg no UALG TEC Campus que automatiza o ar condicionado de hotéis.

organisations.pt: Financiamento PRR a fundo perdido para a plataforma de sensores e dados dos seis municípios.

organisations.name: PRR scholarships for the AuroraMed and UAlg AI course

organisations.ai: Funds AI training for healthcare leaders: directly about AI.

organisations.name: Quarteira Lab (Câmara Municipal de Loulé, with Fundo Ambiental)
organisations.what: A decarbonisation living lab around Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, co-financed by the Fundo Ambiental, with a people and bicycle counter feeding a data platform.
organisations.ai: Sensors and a data platform in the street: a base for analytics, no AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Laboratório vivo de descarbonização em torno da Avenida Dr. Carlos Mota Pinto, cofinanciado pelo Fundo Ambiental, com um contador de pessoas e bicicletas ligado a uma plataforma de dados.

organisations.name: Radar Social (PRR pilot, Alcoutim council)
organisations.what: A PRR-funded social response with a two-person team and 169,302.59 euros. Its second phase, due to run to March 2026, sets up a social georeferencing system to locate people and families at risk and the resources around them.
organisations.ai: A georeferenced map of people at risk is the dataset on which AI risk-flagging could be built. The article names no software and does not mention AI.
organisations.pt: Resposta social financiada pelo PRR, com uma equipa de duas pessoas, que cria um sistema de georreferenciação social para localizar pessoas e famílias em risco.

organisations.name: Re-Source 3.0 (Sociedade Ponto Verde) behind ALGAR's AI tool
organisations.what: The programme under which ALGAR and NILG.AI built the AI recycling-point tool. One report puts the investment at 50 thousand euros.
organisations.ai: The programme funded an AI tool for a Loulé-municipality company.
organisations.pt: O programa no âmbito do qual a ALGAR e a NILG.AI criaram a ferramenta de IA para ecopontos.

organisations.name: REAVER (PRR, Municipio de Alcoutim as beneficiary)
organisations.what: A council project on how sustainable forest production and agroforestry can reverse desertification and the effects of depopulation, by quantifying the value of ecosystem services. 124,800 euros of EU support, 6 September 2022 to 31 December 2025.
organisations.ai: Quantifying ecosystem services and land change is data and modelling work, a third-step base for AI. The sheet mentions no AI.
organisations.pt: Um projeto da câmara sobre a forma como a produção florestal sustentável e a agrofloresta podem inverter a desertificação e os efeitos do despovoamento, quantificando o valor dos serviços dos ecossistemas. 124.800 euros de apoio europeu, de 6 de setembro de 2022 a 31 de dezembro de 2025.

organisations.name: Regional funding call for the UAlg technology campus
organisations.what: A call of 10 million euros at 60% funding, with the application to ALGARVE 2030 expected around February 2025, for a campus whose focus areas are digital, data and AI. Funding was not fully secured at the time of the report.
organisations.ai: Funds a campus whose stated focus includes AI.
organisations.amount: 10 million euros available in the call
organisations.pt: Aviso de 10 milhões de euros com 60% de financiamento, para um campus dedicado ao digital, aos dados e à IA. O financiamento não estava garantido à data da notícia.

organisations.name: Robotics4Farmers (PRR agenda, with Municipio de Alcoutim as a named partner)
organisations.what: An 11-partner consortium building collaborative, intelligent, eco-efficient farm robots, first for vines, olives and almonds, with a herbicide-free solar-heat weeding platform. The council's own project sheet lists the Municipio de Alcoutim among the beneficiaries and gives the region of intervention as Portugal (Alcoutim). It ran from 1 May 2022 to 30 September 2025 with 117,760.56 euros of EU support. The project page names Instituto Superior Tecnico, the desertification centre and an Elvas olive growers association among its partners.
organisations.ai: The project page says it uses learning algorithms to classify weeds, seasonal prediction models and AI-guided cameras, so it is directly about AI. Alcoutim's council is a beneficiary and the sheet places the intervention in Alcoutim. The sheet does not say what was tested there.
organisations.pt: Consórcio de 11 parceiros que constrói uma plataforma robótica para controlar ervas daninhas sem herbicidas, com calor solar concentrado. A Câmara de Alcoutim é uma das parceiras.

organisations.name: S2AQUAcoLAB
organisations.what: Collaborative laboratory for sustainable and smart aquaculture, founded in 2021 and based in Olhão. It lists technological developments, from robotics to AI, among its research lines, and leads DigiATLA.
organisations.ai: Names AI as a research line (2022 report); leads digital aquaculture work.
organisations.pt: Laboratório colaborativo de aquacultura sustentável e inteligente, fundado em 2021 e sediado em Olhão, com a robótica e a IA entre as suas linhas de investigação.

organisations.pt: Plataforma de rastreabilidade e operações para produtores de sal artesanal, nascida na reserva do Sapal de Castro Marim, com 30 dias de experiência gratuita.

organisations.pt: Empresa local de equipamentos e tecnologia médica, apresentada no sexto fórum de ideias de negócio da câmara, a 27 de outubro de 2026.

organisations.what: Marine biotechnology company in Sagres that develops drugs from marine compounds, led by a chronic pain candidate called Sea4Pain. Spin-off of Nova Medical School, working from Porto da Baleeira.

organisations.pt: Empresa de biotecnologia marinha em Sagres que desenvolve medicamentos a partir de compostos marinhos. Spin-off da Nova Medical School, no Porto da Baleeira.

organisations.ai: Runs AI workshops in Lagos.

organisations.ai: Its own PRR project adds AI to production and decision support.
organisations.pt: Empresa de rações para aquacultura em Olhão com um projeto PRR, IA@SPAROS, para levar ferramentas de IA à produção e às decisões.

organisations.ai: Builds AI-made holograms and co-develops projects with UAlg.

It built the AI hologram used on stage by the band D'ZRT in 2023 (trained on more than 9,000 recordings), has an R&D consortium with the University of the Algarve, and is developing AI.EVENT, which reads audience reactions at events, with European funding per RTP.

organisations.ai: A smart-city incubator whose community hosts AI discussions.

organisations.what: Has a small existing campus in Portimão and a signed protocol with the council for a new technology-focused campus at Barranco do Rodrigo, with digital, data and AI as focus areas, linked by its rector to research with the Autódromo and Celerator technology park.
organisations.ai: Plans a Portimão campus focused on digital, data and AI.
organisations.pt: Tem um pequeno campus em Portimão e um protocolo com a câmara para um novo campus tecnológico no Barranco do Rodrigo, dedicado ao digital, aos dados e à IA.

organisations.name: Universidade do Algarve and CCMAR, Sagres marine biology laboratory
organisations.what: A teaching and research laboratory at Porto da Baleeira, planned with the municipality and funded by the Fosteam@South project, about 2.1 million euros of Recovery and Resilience money, as reported in June 2023. The Universidade do Algarve's page shows the Sagres Marine Station hosted the Sagres Marine Science Festival from 6 to 9 May 2026, with the municipality as co-organiser.
organisations.ai: Candidate only. The article describes reef mapping and sampling, not AI. Path: marine research, then ocean data and mapping, then AI analysis. Unconfirmed.
organisations.pt: Laboratório de ensino e investigação no Porto da Baleeira, planeado com o município e financiado pelo projeto Fosteam@South.

organisations.name: University of the Algarve (R&D consortium with SPIC)
organisations.what: UAlg's own page says it has a research and development consortium with Loulé's SPIC on information technology and human-interaction research. UAlg's campuses are in Faro and Portimão, so the link here is the partnership.
organisations.ai: UAlg co-develops AI projects with a Loulé company.
organisations.pt: A UAlg diz ter um consórcio de investigação e desenvolvimento com a SPIC, de Loulé, em tecnologias de informação e interação humana.

organisations.name: Venture Lab by Algarve STP
organisations.what: Free mentoring for 12 validated Algarve startups and SMEs, funded by Algarve 2030. The 2026 call closed on 24 June.
organisations.pt: Mentoria gratuita para 12 startups e PME validadas do Algarve, financiada pelo Algarve 2030. O aviso de 2026 fechou a 24 de junho.

organisations.name: Vicentina, development association of the southwest (LEADER local action group, Adere programmes)
organisations.what: Regional development association whose funding calls have covered Vila do Bispo with Aljezur and Monchique. A 2020 call, +CO3SO Emprego Interior, funded job creation including self-employment in micro and small firms in low-density areas, 2.0 million euros across three measures. The call is old, so check what is open now.
organisations.pt: Associação de desenvolvimento regional cujos avisos abrangeram Vila do Bispo, Aljezur e Monchique. O aviso de 2020 é antigo, por isso confirme o que está aberto agora.

organisations.name: Vilamoura World (Arrow Global), developer and marina operator
organisations.what: Develops Vilamoura and its new 68-berth marina, designed with remote monitoring of water and electricity use at the berths and charging points for electric boats (reported January 2024).
organisations.ai: The resort owner runs metered, remotely monitored infrastructure, a data base for optimisation tools. No AI claimed in the source.
organisations.pt: Desenvolve Vilamoura e a sua nova marina de 68 lugares, com monitorização remota de água e eletricidade e carregadores para barcos elétricos.

organisations.name: We Stream Algarve
organisations.what: Local business on the council's 'Os nossos Empreendedores' page (page 3 of 4), listed together with Substância3D as 3D and streaming services, described there in terms of technology, communication, online work and digital solutions.
organisations.ai: 3D and streaming are digital media services where AI tools for video and imaging are common. The page does not mention AI, so this is a lead to check, not an AI claim.
organisations.pt: Negócio local da página 'Os nossos Empreendedores' da câmara, listado com a Substância3D como serviços de 3D e streaming.

organisations.name: Zoomarine Algarve
organisations.what: Visitor attraction named as one of the stakeholders engaged around the TMCT conference. Its exact role is not stated in the source.
organisations.ai: A local business engaged around a conference with AI sessions.
organisations.pt: Parque temático indicado como uma das entidades envolvidas na conferência TMCT. O seu papel exato não é indicado na fonte.
